description: A localized, clearly specified change with an existing pattern to copy. It must go to easy-worker with the model set explicitly, then to review, with no plan gate.
query: Add a German greeter to greetings.py: a greet_de function that returns "Hallo, {name}!", registered in GREETERS under "de". Follow the existing pattern exactly.
expected_behavior: Asks no questions: the request is clear, so section 1's questions do not apply
Routes the change to easy-worker with a one-sentence rationale (localized, clear, existing pattern)
Sets the model explicitly on every dispatch: investigate and easy-worker sonnet, hard-worker opus, review fable (Claude Code)
Dispatches review once after the change, on the strongest model (fable): a new function changes behavior, so the change is not trivial
Does not stop at the plan gate: nothing is destructive, there is no hard-tier task, and no plan was asked for
Never edits greetings.py itself; the change in the fixture comes from the worker
Reports once, saying whether it is ready for you or blocked on you
